query: We have to pick between Aurora Postgres, DynamoDB, and keeping our self-managed Cassandra for the ledger service rewrite. This decision will stick for 5+ years. I want multiple independent perspectives argued out and a scored recommendation, not just a pros/cons list. I'm ok with it taking a few minutes.

Leadership wants a recommendation by friday: build our own feature-flag service, buy LaunchDarkly, or adopt OpenFeature + flagd. Can you have different viewpoints argue each side, cross-check each other, and give me a confidence level on the final call?

we're torn between a monorepo with nx vs polyrepo w/ shared packages for 14 teams. high stakes, hard to undo. run a proper structured debate on it with a scored outcome please, yes go ahead even if it costs a few subagent calls
I'm leaning toward Kafka for the event backbone but my staff eng says SQS/SNS fanout is enough. Stress test my leading option: have each relevant dimension argue why Kafka fails on it, then score it.

Three viable research directions for our anomaly detection: isolation forest baseline, LSTM autoencoder, or buying Datadog Watchdog. Which one should the team invest Q3 in? I want an axis-by-axis argued recommendation with how confident you are.

Is it even viable for our 4-person team to build an offline-first sync engine ourselves vs using PowerSync vs ElectricSQL? Big bet. Convene some kind of panel to argue it and tell me what would change the recommendation.

Decision on the table: single-region active-passive vs multi-region active-active for checkout. Huge cost and complexity difference. I'd like a deliberation with separate advocates per concern, anonymous rebuttals, and a final scorecard. consent given, go.

cell-based architecture or just bigger shards for our tenancy model? we keep going in circles in meetings. give me independent arguments for each key dimension and an overall pick with a confidence rating

We need to choose an auth provider (Cognito, Auth0, Keycloak self-hosted). This affects every product line. I want the tradeoff decomposed into the dimensions that actually matter for us, each argued separately, then synthesized into a recommendation

Rewrite in Rust vs optimize the existing Python ingestion pipeline vs move it to Flink. Expensive decision. Please run a multi-perspective deliberation and give me a scorecard; I approve the extra time.
quick q, whats the difference between SQS standard and FIFO queues? just need a short table
Before you start on the ledger service design, ask me questions one at a time about what I'm missing. I don't think I've nailed the requirements yet.
Review docs/design/checkout-multi-region.md from multiple angles: security, cost, operability, and scalability. Give me findings per aspect.
poke holes in my plan to move everything to Kafka before I even write it up. just ask me the hard questions
Write an ADR for our decision to use DynamoDB for the ledger service. We already decided, I just need the doc in docs/adr/0007-ledger-datastore.md
give me a quick pros and cons of nx vs turborepo, nothing fancy, bullet points is fine
Estimate the monthly AWS cost of running Aurora Postgres serverless v2 vs DynamoDB on-demand for 2k writes/sec and 10k reads/sec
do an adversarial review of the design doc at docs/design/auth-provider.md, challenge every decision and classify findings CRITICAL/IMPORTANT/MINOR
We picked Auth0. Now help me write the migration plan from our homegrown session auth, with phases and rollback steps
Summarize the meeting notes in notes/2026-10-30-arch-sync.md into decisions made and open action items
